newsitem.title: LATVIA: Unibanka rises further on buoyant Latvian bourse.
newsitem.headline: Unibanka rises further on buoyant Latvian bourse.

text.p: Shares in leading bank Unibanka gained further on the Latvian stock exchange on Wednesday as most shares put in gains amid active trade.
Unibanka climbed to 2.80 lats from 2.70 lats and traded 41,151 lats out of total market business of 131,855 lats.

The other official list stocks, Riga Transport Fleet and Staburadze, were not so well traded, turning over 7,725 lats and 5,454 lats respectively. RTF gained to 1.03 lats from one lat and Staburadze added 35 santimes to 2.70 lats.
The secondary list was led again by Daugavpils Chain, which traded 43,715 lats and rose to 1.43 lats from 1.25.
The Kaija fish cannery was also active on turnover of 20,176 lats and it rose to 1.30 lats from 1.22 lats.

Other active secondary market stocks included the Lode Brick company on trade of 3,731 lats and it rose to 1.29 lats from 1.23 while the Roja fish cannery traded 3,560 lats and gained to 1.78 from 1.55 lats.
Fish cannery Salacgriva climbed to 2.70 from 2.35 on turnover of 3,105 lats.
